name: SourceTrail
label: Source trail
description: The sources an agent opened while answering, as a collapsible list with per-item status.

props.name: items
props.description: The sources, in the order the agent opened them.

props.name: title
props.description:
Header text. Left unset, it is computed from the items —
"Reading 3 sources" while any is still pending or active,
"Read 3 sources" once every visit has settled.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which SourceTrail does not expose.

props.name: readingLabel
props.description:
The computed header while any visit is pending or active, or while
`streaming`, given the number of sources. Defaults to "Reading 1 source"
or "Reading N sources". Ignored when `title` is set.

props.name: readLabel
props.description:
The computed header once every visit has settled, given the number of
sources. Defaults to "Read 1 source" or "Read N sources". Ignored when
`title` is set.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Visually hidden text announcing each row's status after its source. Merged over the English defaults (Not opened yet, Reading now, Read).

props.name: streaming
props.description: Still researching: newly appended rows animate in.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state for controlled use. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires whenever the panel opens or closes.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router; passed on to each source's SourceChip. Wins over a
LinkProvider's; a plain `<a>` when neither is set.
